concepts.name: Isthmus of Panama
concepts.definition: Narrow land bridge linking North and South America across Panama, separating the Caribbean Sea from the Pacific Ocean and traversed by the Panama Canal.

concepts.name: Isthmus of Kra
concepts.definition: The narrowest part of the Malay Peninsula, in southern Thailand, only about 44 km wide between the Andaman Sea and the Gulf of Thailand.

concepts.name: Isthmus of Suez
concepts.definition: The roughly 125-km land bridge in Egypt joining Africa to Asia and separating the Mediterranean from the Red Sea, cut through by the Suez Canal.

concepts.name: Bosporus
concepts.definition: Narrow strait through Istanbul in northwest Turkey linking the Black Sea to the Sea of Marmara and separating Europe from Asia.

concepts.name: Strait of Hormuz
concepts.definition: Strategic strait connecting the Persian Gulf to the Gulf of Oman, separating Iran from Oman's Musandam Peninsula.

concepts.name: Suez Canal
concepts.definition: Artificial sea-level waterway across Egypt's Isthmus of Suez, running 193 km to connect the Mediterranean Sea with the Red Sea.
